name: claude-harness
description: The Claude Harness family: Claude Code plugins that ship with the Claude Harness VS Code extension

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: The Claude Code side of Claude Harness: guards a repo's root CLAUDE.md and skill leaves on every edit, halts or steers a long run from a file at the project root, holds the end of a session that changed source until a verification receipt exists (opt-in), offers the extension's views as @harness: mentions, and ships the harness standard with its check, fix and scaffold scripts and the align-harness, scaffold-repo-harness and cli skills
